steps.title: Blank
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as v_pulley.ipt.
Sketch the half section on the XZ Plane: hub 2.13 in diameter x 1.51 in, web 0.38 in thick, rim 4.30 to 5.63 in diameter x 1.63 in wide. Revolve 360 degrees about the axis.
steps.note: The drawing is in inches; the model is in millimetres (x 25.4).

steps.title: V groove
actions: Sketch the groove: 80 degrees included (40 degrees each side of the centre line), root on a 4.75 in diameter. Revolve, Cut.
steps.note: The 0.38 in ball on the sheet is a gauge for checking the groove.

steps.title: Lightening holes
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Pattern panel > Circular Pattern
actions: Hole 0.76 in diameter, Through, on the 3.43 in pitch circle. Circular Pattern: 8 at 45 degrees.
steps.note: Lightening holes take weight out of the web without making it weaker where the load goes.

steps.title: Groove root fillet
actions: Fillet the root of the V R0.10 in (2.54).

steps.title: Bore chamfers
actions: Chamfer the bore 0.03 in x 45 degrees both ends.
